note: F0-S2 synthetic pull, 100 comps, generated by closed-form recipe so it is reproducible from this description alone (no RNG): for i in range(100) -- cohort_year = 2025 + i%2; sqft = 800 + (i%11)*45, absent when i%7 == 3; initial_ask = 1800 + (i%17)*65; censored when i%9 == 4 (removal_class null); otherwise the ladder cycles confirmed/provisional/pending every 3; effective_dom = 5 + (i*3)%90; a price cut when i%5 == 0; withdrawal-suspect when i%13 == 6; address = '{100+i*7} W Synthetic Row' unit '{1+i%4}'. Exists only so the '<100ms at 100 comps' AC is measured at the size it names. PRE-SHAPED (see synthetic-basic.json); fetched_at is in the past by design. ROW 10B: every comp also states first_listed -- the stitched start date real shaping always sets (pipeline/shape.py::_build_comp) and the date removed_on, and therefore DerivedComp.days_since_removal, is measured from. Without it a removed comp went over the wire carrying a removal rung beside a null count, i.e. the row 'removed nulld -- classifying', while responses.py declares that field null IFF removal_class is null. first_listed is not free: cohort_year is its year, removed_on is it plus effective_dom, and the removal rung is the ladder applied to as_of minus removed_on -- so the pre-shaped format lets an author state one fact four times, which is how they drifted apart. backend/tests/unit/test_r10b_preshaped_pulls_are_shapeable.py re-ties them, over this directory's listing rather than a fixed list of filenames, so a new pre-shaped pull is covered the day it is added. ROW 10B AMENDS THE RECIPE ABOVE: cycling the ladder rung and the censored DOM independently of the cohort year emits comps real shaping cannot produce, so those two are now functions of first_listed rather than free parameters. 28 rungs were recomputed from their own dates (a 2025 listing is not 'pending' on 2026-05-04), 6 censored comps took the DOM their own cohort year implies (-> 124, the floor from 2025-12-31 to the pull date), and 11 price cuts dated 2025-09-14 on a 2026 listing were moved to their spell's midpoint. All four rungs and censoring are still represented (56 confirmed / 17 provisional / 16 pending / 11 censored). cohort_year, sqft and initial_ask -- everything premium and the anchor are computed from -- are exactly as the recipe generated them, and this pull is only ever used as the 100-comp perf ref anyway.
